name: Hina Asuka
source:
Age: 17 (in Togireta Film), 18 (in encore).
Likes: Fighting games and hot [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nata_de_coco]Nata de coco[/url] juice.

A third-year student at Ayazono high school, and [url=/c11811]Haruto[/url]'s kouhai. Asuka is the younger sister of [url=/c11819]Yuusuke[/url], who was a friend of Haruto's and died a year ago. She has a part-time job at a fast food restaurant. She is a close friend of [url=/c11809]Miumi[/url], as well as her classmate.
Asuka is a bright, friendly and brave girl who sometimes reminds of a little devil. Her lack of sense of direction is catastrophic, she is almost like a deadly machine with no common sense. But once you get used to know her, it's not that critical... Or is it? 
She was a child actress on TV or doramas but she's no longer in that business. 

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/5/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
